translations.web: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by Yahweh’s name, and they will be afraid of you.
translations.bsb: Then all the peoples of the earth will see that you are called by the name of the LORD, and they will stand in awe of you.
translations.kjv: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid
translations.asv: And all the peoples of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of Jehovah; and they shall be afraid of thee.
